tables: THE ENTAILMENT LAW, RATIFIED (brief ADDENDUM 13 part A, 2026-09-11; read the addendum whole): A. THE LAW, as ratified (ADDENDUM 10's six items re-cut; the numbering is kept) 1. STANDS. A recorded noun licenses what the word MEANS, never what the thing typically HAS. Age, height, condition, manning, prosperity, a cause, a history, a count, a season, what the thing is usually for elsewhere: NOT entailed; each needs its own read. 2. STANDS, SHARPENED. An attribute that varies across the recorded class is spoken only through a DERIVED FILL computed from the recorded name. The {defmaterial} fill is chartered with the value table of O-1: Palisade → timber; Town walls · City walls and gates · Massive walls and fortifications → stone; Citadel · Gates (if walled) · Palisade or earthworks → NO FILL (a variant naming the slot drops). UNTIL it is minted, no face names a wall's material (writer bar W11); a material SOURCE ("cut from its own woods", "the stone of the country") is NEVER licensed, because the fortification chain feeds every wall row quarried stone (supplyChainData.js:873-884). The two {defwork} residuals ("palisade or earthworks" and "gates (if walled)" reach the page as literals) are a wiring row for CAR 8b-W-2; until then a writer treats {defwork} as an opaque recorded name and writes no sentence whose grammar breaks on either literal. 3. CORRECTED. The sentence "the {defwork} keeps itself, and the muster's wages do not" is STRUCK from the law (X-31): R-viii′ of ADDENDUM 12 replaces it — ONE purse over wall maintenance and garrison wages; the wall STANDS THROUGH the shortfall; never "keeps itself", never the wall paid and the muster not, never the muster thinning. The rest of item 3 stands: the engine's own model bounds every entailment; "timber rots" and "stone endures" are refused even where common sense agrees (walls never decay; the one decay clock over built fabric is the calamity-scar half-life, keyed on the calamity kind, not on any material). 4. CORRECTED (X-33, O-20). settled is the producer token heartland = the LOW monster-and-raider tier of the country (the stress roll multiplies siege and monster by 0.3 and occupation by 0.4; stressGenerator.js:121, :168); never "no live threat", never "the centre of a realm", never founded. W2 of ADDENDUM 12 already bars a totality over the town. frontier is the DEFAULT of an unmeasured town (normalizeMonsterThreat(undefined) === 'frontier') and is never read as a fact unless the raw value is measured (the desk already refuses it). plagued = monster activity, never disease (stands). 5. CORRECTED (X-32, O-2, O-3). The always-safe class words for the paid military are "the muster" and "the town's force"; below town the engine's own generic is "the community". STRUCK from the always-safe list: "the guard" (the power generator's FALLBACK label when NO force row matches, governanceNarrative.js:506, on which town the safety profile prints "no meaningful guard presence"; safe only where hasMilitaryInst) and "the men on the wall" (asserts manning, NOT ENTAILED, and a wall). "The muster roll" as a citation only where a Citizen militia with an instantiated Muster training service resolves. "The watch" as a NAME only where the town resolves Town watch or Professional city watch (town and up; hasWatch is town-plus); "keeps watch" as an activity HOLDS; the watch's pay sits under the ORDER purse and never under the military gate the pay-gate read measures (the referent law's rule 5 stands: the muster kind does not contain the watch bucket). 6. STANDS, WIDENED. The gate does not walk semantics; the refuters do, and the table is their instrument: a refuter passes an item in ENTAILS, fails one in NOT ENTAILED, fails a CONDITIONAL used without its condition resolved on THIS town's record, and now also fails a LABEL read as English (section 3) and an ALIAS word used where the row it names does not resolve (section 4). The licence card prints entails: lines per read once CAR 8b-W-2 lands; until then the refuters read the table's desk section directly. B. THE WRITER BARS W11–W19 (bind every writer, gate, refuter and judge from DEF-2 on; a breach is a FAIL with the bar named; each bar stands until its wiring row lands and the chair lifts it here) W11 THE MATERIAL BAR: no wall material and no material source in any face until {defmaterial} is minted; a shipped "stone" or "timber" clause is the corpus's known breach and is dropped by the rewrite, never kept as a floor. W12 THE GARRISON BAR: "the garrison" only where a Garrison or Multiple garrisons row resolves on the roster (city tier), never from a Barracks (a housing row) or the watch; where an occupation is on the page the face says WHOSE ("{counterpart}'s garrison", "the occupier's men") or uses "the soldiers"; an occupation never entails a garrison present. W13 THE WATCH BAR: as item 5; the pay-gate read never uses "the watch"; a corpus row that asserts a watch off a key that reads no watch row is a breach the rewrite cures. W14 THE LABEL BAR: an engine label is rendered at its ENGINE meaning as section 3 states it, never at its dictionary sense. The defense desk's own ten: plagued (monsters); settled (the low tier); hasGranary (a tier proxy: every town-plus, no village-and-below, whatever it stores); hasChurch (true on every hamlet from a church in another settlement); hasCourtSystem (every town and city, from a meeting hall; a civil arbitration is recorded, a criminal trial is not); hasPort (never the sea; the sea only off a Shipyard row or maritimeSupported); hasGates (fires on a palisade); the Town watch's gate duty (recorded on gateless towns); scores.magical (reads a world, not a town); the readiness label (moves with tier and country while no works move). The other desks' labels bind their blocks when those desks come up. W15 THE ALIAS BAR: a generic English word is used only where the row it names resolves on this town's record; otherwise the always-safe spelling of section 4: "the works" or "what the town has built" (any wall-class member); "the muster" / "the town's force"; "the stores" / "what the town holds back"; "the way in by water"; "the approach" / "the country outside"; "the land" / "what the town raises"; "a house of the faith" / "the parish"; "those tending the sick"; "the {seat}" filled from its own name or "the governing body" (never "the hall", "the council", "the chamber" baked); "the town's own reckoning" (never "the rolls" or "the clerks" as a citation); "the instrument" / "the document" and {term} (never "the tribute" or "the cap on arms" for a family); "a working plurality" (never "a majority"); "the mill" only where the resolved row is a grain mill. W16 THE GATE'S WORD: "upkeep" and "the keeping" are the always-safe words for the military gate (the engine names it the economic-UPKEEP gate over "garrison wages, wall maintenance", defenseGenerator.js:186); "wages" and "pay" of the muster are the engine's own words and stay licensed under R-viii′, but never a sum, a rate, a share, a season, arrears or desertion, and never WHOSE beyond the class word (X-1: the gate fires on a wage-less village with a part-time militia; that is a wiring finding, section D, not a writer's fault). W17 THE CRISIS BAR (cross-desk, from the stressors and war tables): a siege entails a besieger, never walls, gates, a watch or an army at the walls; an occupation entails a foreign writ and taxed revenue, never a garrison present or the town's own hall; wartime never entails hardship (the record's own profit coin) and never a garrison; a famine never entails a harvest failure or a season; a disease outbreak is "illness" or "sickness", never "the plague" and never "not yet a plague" (the two records contradict); an insurgency is never armed on the generation record. W18 THE STRESS-RECORD BAR: a generation-built stress licenses the type's static definition AND the factions, the safety sentence and the deltas the same token minted; an APPLY_STRESSOR entry licenses the static definition only; a world stressor's stage, age and severity are the ORIGIN's; a birth-time origin variant licenses past tense only; unattributed and palace_coup license nothing beyond the type. W19 THE FAITH BAR: the creed by the deity's NAME with nothing predicated of the deity (the deity doctrine, constitutional); rank, standing, legitimacy and contested each at its own engine sense (L-122, L-123), never one for another; live: false is "no measured standing yet", never "newly founded". READ BEFORE WRITING: rewrite/entailment/ENTAILMENT-TABLE.draft.md section 2 for your desk, section 3 (label traps) and section 4 (alias traps); a CONDITIONAL entailment is used only where its condition resolves on THIS town's record as the licence card prints it; a refuter fails a breach of any bar W11 to W19 with the bar named. THE REFERENT LAW, RATIFIED (brief ADDENDUM 13 part B, 2026-09-11; read the addendum whole): A. THE LAW, as ratified (ADDENDUM 11's five rules re-cut; the layer vocabulary widened) 1. THE LAYERS (rule 1 stands; the vocabulary is widened per OW-13 and X-D4 — the marker tags every claim with ONE of these): BODY (an institution row the read reaches, by the bucket or the flag; the noun is the row's own class word); HOLDER (a record's keeper the card resolves — treasury · muster · census · parish · toll-bar · market · watch · court · elders · tradition · road · office — citable ONLY by its kind's ratified nouns; a STATE ORGAN only for office · court · treasury · watch); ORGAN-UNDER-POWER (a state organ where the town is captured at the WORLD threshold corrupted or capture, or the organ's row carries a corruption impairment — never at adversarial or equilibrium, which are player-face rungs; the power named only through a typed slot or the class word); POWER (a typed faction NAME through its slot, or the class words "the ruling structure", "the seat", "another power", "an outside power", "the occupier", "the criminal interest"); ROLE (an office the engine EMITS, stated as a standing condition, never an act and never a fate); AGGREGATE (a band, score, label or ladder rung computed over bodies — it names NO body: the band's own word only); NONE (a stock, a balance, a status, a terrain token, an absence, a condition — no institution noun of any layer); EXTERNAL BODY (a foreign force with its possessor stated: "the occupier's men", "the besieger"); TRADITION ({creed}: the creed by the deity's NAME, nothing predicated of the deity). PERSON is never a referent — BY PRODUCT SCOPE, not by measurement (X-D3, OW-12: the engine DOES carry a typed NPC-to-institution edge; the institution table chooses not to read it; ADDENDUM 11's "no typed edge exists" is corrected to "the institution table reads no such edge"). A recorded NAME may be printed through a typed {npc} slot on a read that records it (DS-REL-1's member receipt; DS-POW-3's ladder, gated at the caller) as a NAME with no predicate on the person — that keeps the two RESOLVED pools lit; any act, decision, disposition or fate on a person is refused (W22). 2. RULE 2 STANDS: the marker's skeleton tags every claim's layer beside its licence, and a refuter fails a face whose noun's layer does not match its read's. The licence card does NOT yet print the layer (OW-21) — until CAR 8b-W-2 adds the referent column, the REFUTER is the instrument and reads the table's desk section. 3. RULE 3 AMENDED (OW-15): SAME WORD, SAME REFERENT, SAME ROW. Where the body and the organ are ONE catalogue row (Town watch / Professional city watch: the watch bucket and the watch holder kind resolve the same rows, OV-3), a unit may carry a body read and an organ read on that row only with the layer change stated in words. A proper slot whose VALUE contains a class word ('Military/Guard', 'Corrupt Council', "the Temple Guard") renders the NAME, and no clause may treat the class word inside it as a body or a standing. {seat} and {faction} fill from ONE string on the power desk: a unit never names both (DS-POW-2's drop is the lawful form until the register car separates them). 4. RULE 4 AMENDED (OW-10): visibility follows the power layer AND the person-rooted covert channel — a covert corruption impairment, an unexposed corrupt officer homed at a security body, a birth capture at corrupted/capture, a covert posture, a covert bloc and foreign funding are the DM face (the pen line names the OFFICE, never the officer); a brokerage patron's visibility follows the HOUSE's legality; a revealed impairment is a public scandal both faces may name. Until the branch-aware covert flag and the caller-side carriers are censused (register rows), the AUTHORED dm-only mark is the carrier and the census covert column is read by nobody as a licence. 5. RULE 5 RE-CUT (OW-1, OV-4, DG-2, DG-8): the pay-gate fact is the ENGINE'S PRODUCER, not the holder table — the gate counts the watch (hasAnyDefense), and fieldSynonyms calls it "the town's pay for its watch"; so on a pay-gate read the safe forms are "the keeping", "the upkeep", the gate's own nouns (pay · wages · purse) and the person-plural class word ("the town's force", "the soldiers"); NEITHER institution NAME ("the watch", "the muster roll") until the {watchname} fill lands; "the muster" stays the CLASS word for the paid military everywhere (a class word asserts no roll); "the muster roll" / "the roll" as a RECORD only where a Citizen militia with the Muster training service resolves (OV-5). DS-DEF-11's landed STRAINED lines stand under R-viii′ (the class word + the gate's noun). The alias overlaps OV-1…OV-39 are wiring facts for the register car (rule 5's second half stands). B. THE WRITER BARS W20–W27 (bind every writer, gate, refuter and judge from DEF-2 on, beside W1–W19; a breach is a FAIL with the bar named) W20 THE LAYER BAR: a noun is used at the layer of its READ, as the skeleton tags it. A body word on an AGGREGATE or NONE read is refused — a readiness badge, a safety label, a score band, a capture rung, a stock band, a terrain token or a condition names no watch, garrison, wall, granary, hall or market (D-F2, G-F2, G-F7, E-F6, S-F1 …): the band's own word carries the sentence. A body word is licensed only where the pool's read reaches the row (the census reads line and the card). W21 THE BAKED-POWER BAR: never "the hall", "the council", "the chamber", "the seat's people" as the power. The power is the {seat} slot filled from its own name, or the class words "the ruling structure" / "the seat". On a CAPTURE read (criminalCaptureState) the CLASS WORD replaces {seat} until seatKind lands (OW-3: the slot can render a ROLE or a standing-laden label as the organ). The six ruling-power words (autocrat · council · theocracy · merchant_league · criminal · mixed) are lens VALUES, safe only as the pool they key, never as a body. W22 THE PERSON BAR: no person as agent, decider, holder of a permission, chooser, or load-bearing referent ("somebody", "whoever", "the person who", "one person's word", "the clerks record", "the collectors travel", "the officers posted", "a ruler with the town behind them"). A ROLE word states a standing condition of an office the engine EMITS (the ROLE instrument: officesOf · ROLE_FACTION_MAP · FACTION_ROLES · TIER_MANDATORY_ROLES: captain · reeve · mayor · elder · priest · healer · overseer · official · guard captain · watch captain · garrison commander · magistrate · warden · steward …) and only on a read that records it; "clerk", "collector", "officer", "administrator", "scout", "heir" have no row and are refused; 'Corrupt Official' is a public role string, never a standing a face may infer. W23 THE FUSED-AGENT BAR: no relation between two referents that no field computes ("the bought watch is paid short"; "the town has decided"; "the hall moves against the operators and the operators move back"; "the resistance is bleeding the garrison"; "the houses that finance the town have decided"). Two facts are two units; one referent per unit. W24 THE RECORD-WORD BAR (OW-14 ruled (a); OW-11): an ORGAN read may use its kind's RATIFIED nouns and no others — treasury: books · purse · chest; muster: roll · rolls · muster; census: roll · rolls · count; parish: register · book · books; toll-bar: book · books · toll; market: book · books · stall; watch: roll · rolls · watch; court: roll · rolls · record; elders and tradition: word · memory; road: book · books; office: book · books · record — never accounts · returns · duties · ledgers · manifests · minutes · the writ · a licence. On a read that resolves NO holder (the card's SOURCE-UNRESOLVED), no record word at all: the fact is stated on the read's own noun ("the rolls" on a population read is refused — the population record is split across three kinds no pool reads; the general refuter's (a) is adopted, the metonym (b) refused). The [ledger] ANGLE is a STANDPOINT — the clerk's way of stating the fact — and licenses NO record noun and no citation ("the books show" is a citation; "entered as standing" is the office's formula, R-vi/W7). W25 THE EXTERNAL-BODY BAR (OW-9, W12): a foreign force is named with its possessor stated — "the occupier's men", "the besieger", "the soldiers" — never a bare "the garrison" for the occupier's force (an occupation record carries no garrison field) and never "{counterpart}'s garrison"; on a TREATY pool {counterpart} is the martial counterpart and never the signatory, so no possessor is stated through it (the side-neutral cells and {term} are the safe forms); 'Unknown Faction (hidden)' through {counterpart} on a player face is a wiring defect (a properFill refusal for the register car), and a writer treats {counterpart} on DS-POW-4 as DM-only until then. W26 THE VISIBILITY BAR (rule 4): a capture at corrupted/capture, a covert impairment, a covert posture, a covert bloc, foreign funding and the attacker's identity are the DM face (the dm-only mark on the variant); the player face says what the state's organs would admit and may say the town does NOT KNOW (the absence is the fact); none · adversarial · equilibrium are player-face rungs; a citing player face on an INTERESTED holder fails (arm A13) — so a player face never cites a state organ's record where the town is captured. W27 THE ANGLE-TAG BAR: [elder], [ledger], [visitor], [street], [unfolding], [counterforce], [threshold] are STANCES. "The elders" as a body only where the elders kind resolves (never from the tag); "a stranger" is the visitor's eye — it may see, never act, decide, be told or be given a name; the stance's nouns are never a holder's record (W24). READ BEFORE WRITING: rewrite/entailment/REFERENT-TABLE.draft.md section 2 for your desk, section 3 (overlaps), section 4 (power slots and visibility) and section 5 for your desk (the wrong-layer findings in the shipped rows - each is a breach the rewrite drops); the marker tags every claim's layer; a refuter fails a breach of any bar W20 to W27 with the bar named.
rulings: THE CHAIR'S RULINGS THAT BIND DS-DEF-2 (from the validation block DS-DEF-11, brief ADDENDUM 12, generalised; and from the entailment table's defense section, ADDENDUM 13 part A): R-i a spine's own second sentence carries a noun forward from its first regardless of k (the thread at k = 0); R-ii a negated surface on a PRESENT read is not an absence opener, at most one per variant (W10); R-iii a USAGE FRAME ('asks little of', 'has little call for', 'sees no use for') is never the threat read - the threat is stated over the COUNTRY as the record holds it, in the angle's stance (W2); R-iv an [unfolding] variant realises OPEN (the matter standing open now) after the presence, never the ledger's measure; R-vi the office's own formula (entered, on the roll, carried standing) is the ledger's lawful surface and the roll as an agent-source (the roll shows, the roll sets down) is a citation the budget does not license (W7); R-viii' on any pay-gate read there is ONE military purse over wall maintenance and garrison wages (a wall STANDS THROUGH a shortfall; never 'keeps itself'; never the muster thinning or deserting) and a SECOND order purse over the watch, the court and the gaol; W16 'upkeep' and 'the keeping' are the always-safe gate words. THE FOUR KNOWN BREACHES IN THIS BLOCK'S SHIPPED ROWS (the defense refuter, entailment table 2.1, section 7; each is DROPPED by the rewrite, never kept as a floor): 'settled, defenses beyond the need' v1 'substantial works' (a magnitude no field holds) and v3 'how relaxed the people on it are' (a manning and a standpoint); 'walls with NO force' v1 'takes this town with ladders' (an earth berm needs none; a forecast); 'granary AND parish care only' v1 'clergy who tend the sick' (hasChurch is true on every hamlet from a church in another settlement and records parishes, not care). THE LABEL TRAPS THIS BLOCK'S READS WALK (W14; the engine meaning, never the English): plagued = monster activity; settled = the LOW monster-and-raider tier (the producer token heartland), never 'no live threat'; frontier is the default of an unmeasured town; 'perimeter' is FALSE of a Citadel (inner) and of Gates (a point) - the safe generic is 'the works' or the {defwork} name; 'organized force' is the force BUCKETS (garrison, militia, watch, mercenary, charter), never 'the guard'; hasGranary is a tier proxy (every town-plus, no village-and-below) and says nothing of the stock; hasHospital fires on a first-level divine healer (a PERSON) and on a monastery that MAY run one - 'a house that takes in the sick' only on a hospital-named row, else 'those tending the sick'; hasChurch / parish care fires on every hamlet and on a resident priest with no building - 'the parish' never 'the church'; hasCourtSystem is every town and city from a meeting hall (a civil arbitration is recorded on most town halls, a criminal trial is not) and Small prison/stocks DOES hold cells; the readiness band word is exactly the ladder's reading and a STRONG badge on one arm says nothing of another; the economic-survival arm is FOOD-STORAGE-driven resilience, never prosperity. THE ALIAS BARS (W12, W13, W15): 'the garrison' only on a Garrison row (city) and with WHOSE where an occupation is on the page; 'the watch' as a name only on a resolved watch row (town-plus); 'the militia' only where forces.militia.present; otherwise 'the muster', 'the town's force', below town 'the community'.
